name: abency-google-meta-ads
description: Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram ads) reporting for marketing agencies and their client brands, from ChatGPT, through Abency.

interface.longDescription: Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram ads) reporting for marketing agencies and freelancers who manage several client accounts. See spend, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions and ROAS for every client, compare periods, find the campaigns, ad groups and search terms that waste budget, and inspect Meta ad sets, ads and creatives. Get a cross-client overview of all your ad accounts in one answer and spot which ones need attention. Every request is scoped to the brands of your Abency organization, and Google Ads and Meta Ads are always reported separately in their own currency.
defaultPrompt: Which of my clients' Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts need attention this week?
Google Ads report for my brand last month with wasted search terms
Compare my Meta Ads campaigns this month vs last month

positive.description: List the brands and which ad platforms each one has connected
positive.prompt: Which of my brands have Google Ads or Meta Ads connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brands of the reviewer's organization (Abency and ADDITIU) and, for each one, whether Google Ads and Meta Ads are connected, based on connected_platforms.

positive.description: Meta Ads performance summary for one brand
positive.prompt: Give me a Meta Ads summary for ADDITIU for the last 30 days: spend, clicks, results and the three campaigns with the most spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the brand's Meta Ads totals for the last 30 full days in the account currency (spend, clicks, CTR, conversions) with the change against the previous period, and a table of the three campaigns with the highest spend.

positive.description: Google Ads campaigns and wasted search terms
positive.prompt: Show me the Google Ads campaigns of Abency for last month and the search terms that spent money without converting.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Google Ads campaigns for the previous calendar month sorted by cost, then the search terms with cost and zero conversions. If the account has no Search campaigns, it says that search terms are not available.

positive.description: Cross-client weekly check of all ad accounts
positive.prompt: Which of my brands' ad accounts need attention this week compared with last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the compare tools once per connected brand and platform, one at a time, and returns one table per platform (Google Ads and Meta Ads kept separate, each in its own currency) with spend, conversions and the change versus the previous 7 days, flagging accounts whose spend rose while conversions fell or that spent without conversions.

positive.description: Inspect the structure and creatives of a Meta campaign
positive.prompt: Open the Meta Ads campaign of ADDITIU with the most spend this month and show me its ad sets, ads and creatives.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the campaign with the highest spend this month and shows its ad sets (optimization goal, status, schedule) and ads with each creative's title, body, call to action and link. Nothing is changed in the ad account.

negative.description: Scheduling social posts is outside this plugin
negative.prompt: Schedule an Instagram post for ADDITIU tomorrow at 10:00 that says "Hello".

negative.description: Brands outside the reviewer's organization are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the Google Ads results of Nike for last month.

negative.description: Sending reports by email is not supported
negative.prompt: Email this month's Meta Ads report to my client at client@example.com.
